features.name: Pay-anywhere tumble
features.description: Eight or more matching symbols anywhere on the 6x5 grid pay and then tumble away.

features.name: Multiplier symbols

features.name: Levelled free spins
features.description: Collected multipliers move you through four levels, each ensuring higher multiplier values.

review:
The familiar 6x5 tumble grid with a levelling bonus. Eight or more matching shields, helmets or rings anywhere pay and tumble away, and multipliers worth 2x to 100x can land on any spin.

In free spins, every multiplier pushes you along a four-level progress bar, and each level raises the minimum multiplier from then on – so a bonus that levels early can be worth far more. A solid Gates of Olympus alternative with clearer progress. 5,000x max, 96.25% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
